description: Power analyser for DIN rail mounting, RS-485 (Modbus RTU) and RS-232
source: Janitza electronics, "Power Analyser UMG 104 Modbus-address list and Formulary", Doc. no. 1.041.006.1.e (2023-01)

sources.title: Power Analyser UMG 104 Modbus-address list and Formulary
sources.note: frequently required readings, date and time, energy and other values

notes: Addresses are the protocol addresses of the address list; all values are holding registers (FC03 read, FC06/FC16 write).
Values are big-endian; the device also serves them little-endian at the same address + 32768.
Not in this map: the 200 ms, mean, minimum and maximum value tables, their time stamps and the Fourier analysis tables.
Serial settings: 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits; 9600 to 115200 baud.
